prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” digital marketing agency in St. Louis — the right agency depends on what you need (SEO, paid media, web design, branding, B2B demand generation, local store marketing, etc.), your budget, industry, and whether you prefer a large full‑service shop or a small specialist.

To help you find the best match, tell me:
- Primary objectives (lead gen, e‑commerce sales, brand awareness, local customers, etc.)
- Industry (B2B, healthcare, retail, legal, startups, etc.)
- Monthly budget or project budget
- Preferred agency size (boutique vs. larger firm)
- Any must‑have services (SEO, PPC, social, web dev, creative)
- Timeline (ongoing or one‑time project)

If you want a quick checklist to evaluate agencies now, use these criteria:
- Relevant case studies and measurable results (traffic, leads, revenue)
- Client references and recent retention history
- Expertise in your industry or channel
- Reporting cadence and KPIs they’ll commit to
- Team structure and who will manage your account
- Pricing model and contract flexibility
- Cultural fit and communication style

Red flags:
- Vague promises (“we’ll get you rankings” with no metrics)
- No examples or references
- Little transparency about who will do the work
- Very low guaranteed pricing with long lock‑in contracts

If you’d like, I can:
- Research and return a tailored top‑5 St. Louis agencies for your needs with pros/cons and estimated pricing
- Provide a short RFP template you can send to agencies
Tell me which option you prefer and give the details above, and I’ll get started.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
